name: omd-procedures
description: Promote a completed OMD workflow task into a versioned, reusable procedure skill packaged as a repository plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Promote completed workflow tasks into procedure skills
interface.longDescription: Draft a reusable procedure from a completed omd_workflow task, promote it explicitly into a versioned skill plugin in the repository, and run it through the same workflow checkpoints and contract.
interface.defaultPrompt: Draft a reusable OMD procedure from this completed workflow task
